messages:
maria_g: Quick sync 0 we need a compact social push for the webinar + benchmark narrative. Outcome goals: signups, UTM'd leads, route high-intent within 30m. Who takes assets, copy, and routing?

jake_p: Ill do X card + alt sizes. Need the benchmark stat, high-res logo, and brand color hex. PNG + square.

olivia_marketing: Ill write 3 variations: short X headline, X thread opener, LinkedIn long form. Also can make 2 short teaser clips if we get recording. Proposed cadences below.

maria_g: Proposed cadence to A/B the hooks:
Mon 10:00 X (benchmark stat + CTA)
Tue 2:00 LinkedIn (long post + customer quote)
Wed 11:30 X thread (3 tweets: method, result, CTA)
Thu 3:00 X reminder (clip)
Fri 9:00 LinkedIn final nudge
All links must include ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may2026&utm_medium=x_or_linkedin

sam_ops: Routing plan: Drift collects form -> HubSpot enriches. Rule: if form_id == "f9c2-web-2026" AND lead.score >= 40 then assign to SDR-Priority queue and ping #sales-inbound, else add to nurture list `webinar_followup_2026`. I can build workflow.

tom_sales: SDR SLA for priority leads = 30m. Need on-call rota and Slack alert. Also want reply snippets for common asks (pricing, dedicated, security).

drift-bot: Drift playbook stub: "Webinar Capture" will post to #marketing-inbound on submission of `f9c2-web-2026`. Configure Playbooks -> Webinars.

jake_p: Asset checklist:
- benchmark stat hero 1200x675 PNG
- 1:1 square 1080x1080
- 16:9 short clip 15s (no audio)
- overlay copy file (editable)
Ill aim for drafts today EOD. Tag files with `bench-test-a` and `prod-test-b`.

olivia_marketing: Copy variants (short):
A: "We cut inference cost by 3.8x  see how. Free webinar + benchmark breakdown. Register: <link>"
B: "Latency vs cost: our benchmark shows the sweet spot. Join our engineers on May 18. RSVP: <link>"
C: "Benchmarks, tradeoffs, and real configs. Webinar  sign up: <link>"
Which headline for the A/B?

maria_g: Use A for benchmark-led, B for product-led. Olivia, schedule both in scheduler and label `bench-test-a` / `prod-test-b`. Jake, tag assets accordingly.

sam_ops: HubSpot workflow: if source == social AND campaign == webinar_may2026 then if lead.score >= 40 assign `sdr_priority` + Slack @channel to #sales-inbound with lead.name and lead.profile; else add to list `webinar_followup_2026`. Pixel: rdw_pixel_2026_web. Ill attach YAML in the ops doc.

maria_g: Budget?

oj: Any paid amp?

maria_g: Small test: $1k split 60/40 X/LinkedIn. Sam, add conversion pixels & measurement.

sam_ops: Pixel added `rdw_pixel_2026_web`. All UTM URLs updated. Workflow draft here: docs internal link.

tom_sales: Ill publish SDR rota and reply library by tomorrow noon. Need 2 people per shift.

maria_g: Action items:
- Jake: deliver assets (EOD)
- Olivia: schedule copy + LinkedIn post (tomorrow AM)
- Sam: HubSpot routing + Slack alerts (EOD)
- Tom: SDR rota + reply library (tomorrow noon)
Review at 4pm in #marketing-ops. :thumbsup:

jake_p: On it.

olivia_marketing: Will share copy drafts in this thread when ready.

sam_ops: Will post workflow YAML link once live.

maria_g: Thanks team  marking owners. Ping me if blockers.
